aligned.explanation: CUDA13.2 cuda.h enables alignas(128) only when __cplusplus>=201103L. Without /Zc:__cplusplus MSVC reports its legacy value and descriptors are insufficiently aligned. Enabling it satisfies the assertion but generated by-value kernel parameter stubs are rejected by MSVC C2719.

scope: This derived CUTLASS dense example is unqualified on the recorded Windows toolchain. No claim that CUTLASS or SM120 is unsupported; no accepted speed/correctness result. FP8 dense also still lacks a supported GGUF type/runtime path; native converter uses the documented Q8 dense fallback.
